description: Reads from Base Mainnet whether a wallet holds an active 7-day pass (needed by verify_endpoint_sla), its expiry (validUntil, secondsLeft), the price (5 USDC), and the wallet's USDC balance and existing allowance to the escrow contract. Use it before verify_endpoint_sla, and after buy_pass's transactions confirm. Free and read-only.

walletAddress.description: Base Mainnet wallet to check, e.g. "0x1234...abcd".

name: check_pass
title: Check a wallet's pass
